note: Naive baselines computed on the identical holdout window and identical (lag_1, roll_mean_4) features the LightGBM model was evaluated on, so this is an apples-to-apples comparison.

weight.verdict: LightGBM beats naive last-week but loses to the plain 4-week moving average. Only 7 SKUs / ~800 training rows - not enough for a tree model to reliably outlearn a simple average here. Treat the weight-SKU model as provisional; the 4-week moving average is the safer default for those 7 SKUs until more weight-priced SKUs are onboarded.
